title: Apply for a research grant or innovation award
summary: When a defined research or innovation project may fit a published funding opportunity. A submitted eligible application or documented no-go, with award conditions separated from funding assumptions.
outcomes: A submitted eligible application or documented no-go, with award conditions separated from funding assumptions.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a defined research or innovation project may fit a published funding opportunity.

parts.title: Match the actual project to published opportunities
parts.guidance: Record the official sponsor, call, applicant rules, project scope, submission date and eligible costs. Distinguish grants from loans and procurement contracts, and reject offers that cannot be verified through the sponsor.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Confirm eligibility and the funding commitment
parts.guidance: The project owner and finance adviser check entity, geography, research and matching-fund conditions. Decide whether the project can proceed if no award is made; an application is not cash or permission to incur reimbursable costs.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Confirm eligibility and the funding commitment

parts.title: Prepare the technical, budget and delivery proposal
parts.guidance: Write the research question, milestones, team capability, evidence and cost basis against the published criteria. Make assumptions and subcontractor dependencies explicit and reconcile totals across the application forms.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve and submit the application
parts.guidance: The authorized applicant checks certifications, budget and final attachments before submitting through the official portal. Retain the submitted copy and receipt and keep requested clarification work in an owned register.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Assess the award decision and accept conditions
parts.guidance: Review the actual award terms, restrictions, milestones, IP provisions and reporting with advisers. Obtain authority before acceptance and hand the agreement to the grant-compliance owner rather than treating selection as unrestricted revenue.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Assess the award decision and accept conditions

verify.how: A submitted eligible application or documented no-go, with award conditions separated from funding assumptions.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
